decisions.reason: As a sheet preparation module that builds directly on the firm's established postpress knowledge and remained on its own webpage in 2024, it fits the firm's absorptive capacity well and shows enough continuity to justify retention.

This folding add-on is very close to the firm's core finishing competence, was still mentioned in 2024, and has a cited customer application demonstrating commercial use, so management would likely keep and refine it rather than withdraw it.
